verdicts.id: belief and the basis of meaning
verdicts.rationale: Both are Davidson's 'Belief and the basis of meaning' (1974). Survivor's note explicitly says originally published in Synthese 27, which matches the second member's journal/volume. Same work, journal-original vs collection-reprint.
Both are Davidson's 'On the Very Idea of a Conceptual Scheme' (1973 APA address / 1984 reprint in Inquiries). Same title and author; the DOI matches the original APA proceedings.

Both members carry identical title (Book Review: Florence in the Forgotten Centuries), author (Davidson, Alastair), volume/number/pages, and DOI. Internally consistent with each other despite a stray misfiled note; the two entries are the same book review.
Both are Davidson's 'Essays on Actions and Events' (Clarendon, ISBN 9780199246267). Second is just marked as edition 2 of the same book.
All three are Davidson's 'Rational Animals' (1982 Dialectica / 2001 reprint in Subjective, Intersubjective, Objective). Same title and author; DOI matches the Dialectica original shared by first two.
Both members identical: 'Weight' by Davidson, Barbara and Pargetter, Robert (Phil Studies 49(2):219-230), same DOI. Same work despite the misleading 'donald' in one citekey.

Both members identical: 'The impact of health economic evaluations in Sweden' (Heintz et al.), same journal, volume, pages, DOI. Same work; the Sinn und Bedeutung booktitle is a spurious leftover field, not a distinguishing feature.
Both members identical: Davies & Humberstone 'Two notions of necessity' (Phil Studies 38(1):1-30), same DOI.

Survivor (DOI 10.3115/1077146.1077163, pages 127, HLT '86 Strategic Computing workshop) and hobbs1986commonsens carry DIFFERENT DOIs (the latter is 10.3115/981131.981163, pages 231-240, 24th ACL meeting). These are distinct publications of a related work; matched only on normalized title+author despite distinct DOIs.

All three are Deacon 'The Symbolic Species' (W.W. Norton, ISBN 9780393317541). Identical bar citekey formatting.
